title: Jamaican Bean Lasagna
description: A flavorful twist on the classic Italian dish, featuring Jamaican spices and beans.
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package instructions.
In a skillet, sauté onion and bell pepper until softened.
Add Jamaican jerk seasoning and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add diced tomatoes and bring to a simmer.
In a separate bowl, combine Jamaican bean mix and zesty cheese.
Assemble lasagna by spreading meat sauce on bottom, followed by noodles, bean mix, and cheese.
Repeat layers two more times, ending with cheese on top.
If using ground beef, cook in skillet until browned and crumbled.
Add cooked beef to meat sauce and simmer for 5 minutes.
Transfer lasagna to a 9x13-inch baking dish and cover with foil.
Bake for 30 minutes, then remove foil and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Let lasagna rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
